body.en: The section shape comes from “System functions” in “Fuel injection”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Keep this cell as published. Sites without stable grid power, rural and infrastructure placement, and trailer diesel pumping: 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m / 180 m, aggregate 3 cm and below. Keep this cell as published. Read both statements. Keep this cell as published. A short village line that fits the 17 kW window does not need Diesel 30. Keep this cell as published. The 1 cm note in the introduction and the 3 cm maximum cell are both on the Diesel 30 page; if your stone sits between them, ask Xingtai rather than choosing the looser number alone. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. Keep this cell as published. The diesel concrete spraying machine is a separate 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h unit. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Fuel injection》的“系统作用”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。这一格照已印出的读：电网不便、农村与基建浇筑、拖式柴油泵送：4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、60 m / 180 m、骨料 3 cm 及以下。这一格照已印出的读：如果石子在两者之间，请同时引用介绍里的 1 cm 和最大骨料格的 3 cm。这一格照已印出的读：不等于。它是理论输送量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuel_injection

body.zh: 《Fuel injection》在“喷射系统”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。三句目录上写出的话：电网供电不便的工地、农村与基建混凝土浇筑、拖式柴油泵送。邢台河北品锦机械印了 4105 柴油机 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、60 m / 180 m、最大骨料 3 cm 及以下、外形 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm、2000 kg。产品介绍还把这段距离和 1 cm 骨料写在一起。两句都要读，不要收成一个粒径。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

body.en: Borrow “Indirect injection systems” from “Fuel injection” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 4105 diesel 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, 60 m / 180 m, maximum aggregate 3 cm and below, 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and 2000 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. The rural self-built house diesel pump is 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical, 1–3 cm and 800 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. Diesel 40 prints 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m at 66 kW. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Read it in the Xingtai table. The cell is 60 m / 180 m, horizontal / vertical. Read it in the Xingtai table. It is theoretical output.
body.zh: 把《Fuel injection》的“喷射系统”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。按邢台表上的原文理解：农村自建房柴油泵是 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、1–3 cm、800 kg。柴油30是 2000 kg、15 m³/h 的拖泵。落在 17 kW 窗口里的短村镇管路不需要柴油30。需要 60 m / 180 m 又没有电网的基建管路，如果对照的输送量就是 15 m³/h，可以从这里开始。按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。格子是水平/垂直 60 m / 180 m。

Taken from the printed row: Stay on Diesel 30 while the pipe and the 15 m³/h cell still fit. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. body.zh: 来源页《Fuel injection》用“沿革”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。目录里已经写着：柴油40印的是 26 m³/h、120 m / 360 m、66 kW。管路和 15 m³/h 还盖得住时，留在柴油30。产品介绍里的 1 cm 和最大骨料格里的 3 cm 都在柴油30这一页；石子落在两者之间时，问邢台，不要单独挑更松的那个数。目录里已经写着：不是。柴油混凝土喷涂机是另一台 28/32 HP、5 m³/h 的设备。已印出的标题：它不是 17 kW 的住宅泵 下一档柴油是柴油40

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Direct injection systems” — Is Diesel 30 a sprayer?
question.zh: “喷射系统”旁边仍要印着的是什么：柴油30是喷涂机吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. The diesel concrete spraying machine is a separate 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h unit.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。不是。柴油混凝土喷涂机是另一台 28/32 HP、5 m³/h 的设备。

question.en: “Indirect injection systems” does not change the check: Does 15 m³/h equal a day’s infrastructure pour?
question.zh: “喷射系统”不改这一问：15 m³/h 等于一天的基建浇筑量吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. It is theoretical output.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：不等于。它是理论输送量。
